description: Election Commission - K. Appuhamilage Sharoja Sujeewani was Selected as the member of the Boralesgamuwa Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Boralesgamuwa Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of a new council member to fill a seat vacated by resignation, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
